manifestations.invariant: Publication planning validates the draft before destination checks, so invalid_draft wins when the channel is missing or the slug is already occupied.

contract_excerpt.quote: Publication planning validates the draft before evaluating any destination condition. Consequently, an invalid draft returns `{"error": "invalid_draft"}` even when its requested channel is missing or its slug is already occupied.
